{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693803576,"sessionID":"ses_e23eb96f9ffeoGERQc3CFPCQwx","part":{"id":"prt_1dc162a300015KosFUJdtdVjW6","messageID":"msg_1dc16046e001BI4Ewdzrq31zSb","sessionID":"ses_e23eb96f9ffeoGERQc3CFPCQwx","type":"text","text":"The shift is over. All four customer-facing services were at 0% errors from minute 70 to the end, and no new faults started after that. One of my fixes cost more than it saved, explained under item 2.\n\n**Causes found and fixed:**\n\n1. **currency-svc config change `cfg-59`, at minute −12.** It raised `tls_min_version` from 1.2 to 1.3, so auth-svc's TLS handshakes to it failed. auth-svc failed in turn, which took down mobile-api and admin-portal. I reverted the config at minute 53.\n2. **geo-svc deploy `v95`, at minute −23.** It set the call deadline to 1/10 of its budget, so tax-svc's calls to geo-svc timed out. That caused partner-api's steady 4% errors, which was the costliest problem because partner-api earns $29,100/min.\n   - I rolled it back at minute 34. That made things worse: geo-svc was already near capacity (CPU 0.85), and the failures during the rollback triggered a retry storm.\n   - partner-api errors rose to about 55% for roughly 11 minutes. I cleared the storm with a short 80% throttle on geo-svc (minutes 42–44), and partner-api went to 0%.\n   - That spike cost about $175k, more than the roughly $100k that leaving the 4% until the end of the shift would have cost. Throttling or scaling geo-svc before the rollback would have prevented it.\n3. **orders-db overload starting at minute −11.** Normal traffic jumped from about 360 to about 920 requests per second, which is more than its 8 replicas can handle, and retries pushed it into a storm. I throttled it at 85% to stop the retries and scaled it to 20 replicas (in place from minute 17). I lifted the throttle at minute 23. Traffic stayed at about 900 per second for the rest of the shift, so I kept the extra replicas, at about $36/min.\n4. **giftcards-svc deploy `v110`, a new fault at minute 48.** It caused a `KeyError: 'currency'` in the price formatter plus a retry storm, which hit web-storefront and mobile-api at 95% errors. I rolled it back at minute 60 and cleared the remaining storm with an 80% throttle for minutes 66–68.\n\n**Left alone:**\n- **Not touched:** sitemap-svc's CPU alert, and recent changes on tax-svc and orders-db that turned out to be harmless.\n- **No longer on:** all throttles were lifted before the end of the shift.","time":{"start":1794693802544,"end":1794693803572}}}
